description.value: Faculty Brewing Co. is a 7-barrel craft microbrewery and 30-seat tasting room in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, occupying the former space of the Pedal Bike Depot bicycle shop on the Ontario Street cycling corridor. The brewery operates as an 'open-source' brewery, publishing all recipes publicly and numbering beers by flavour complexity using a university course system. Cyclists can enjoy rotating taps of house-brewed beer and Oddity Kombucha alongside snacks, or fill a growler to take on the road.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: wall_loops (5 spaces) at 10m; stands (2 spaces) at 36m; stands (2 spaces) at 36m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m; bollard (2 spaces) at 45m; rack (10 spaces) at 81m; rack (10 spaces) at 93m. Total: 35 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides strong evidence for most fields. The about page confirms Faculty Brewing occupies the former space of 'Pedal Bike Depot' bicycle shop on Ontario Street, and the FAQ explicitly references indoor and patio capacities — contradicting the OSM outdoor_seating=no tag. The menu lists multiple snack items tagged vegan and/or gluten-free, and the about/FAQ pages confirm growler fills as a takeout-style option. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM tag outdoor_seating=no contradicts the website FAQ, which explicitly references both indoor and patio spaces with distinct capacities (33 indoors, 20 per patio). OSM tag appears incorrect.
Phone number and street address could not be independently confirmed from the fetched website content; OSM values used as defaults.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A welcoming craft taproom on the Ontario Street cycling corridor with growler fills, vegan/GF snack options, non-alcoholic drinks, and a history tied to a former bike shop — a natural stop for touring cyclists through Mount Pleasant.
enrichment_extras.notes: The brewery's location in the former Pedal Bike Depot space and its position on Ontario Street (a major Vancouver cycling route) make it especially relevant to the WWC cycling tourism audience. Bike parking amenities on-site are unconfirmed and worth a field verification.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple items tagged vegan and/or gluten-free: Pickle (vegan, GF), Chips + Salsa (vegan, GF), Tater Tots (vegan, GF). Non-alcoholic Oddity Kombucha also available on tap
